title: A machine learning framework for uncovering stochastic nonlinear dynamics from noisy data
summary: Modeling real-world systems requires accounting for noise - whether it arises from unpredictable fluctuations in financial markets, irregular rhythms in biological systems, or environmental variability in ecosystems. While the behavior of such systems can often be described by stochastic differential equations, a central challenge is understanding how noise influences the inference of system parameters and dynamics from data.
